after_start.name: Me
after_start.text: *After school. I decide to look around the campus. I still don't know the layout.*

after_start_2.name: Me
after_start_2.text: *I walk down the hallway. My phone buzzes. — The group chat from my old school.*

after_kakao_1.name: Me
after_kakao_1.text: *'Sojeong posted cherry blossom photos with her boyfriend lol'*

after_kakao_2.name: Me
after_kakao_2.text: *I put my phone back in my pocket.*

after_kakao_4.name: Me
after_kakao_4.text: *I'm fine. Really. It's already in the past. I never even confessed and it just ended. It's not lingering feelings — it's regret. — What if I had said something back then? Even if I'd been rejected, at least I wouldn't feel this unsettled.*

after_kakao_5.name: Me
after_kakao_5.text: *At this school — I won't swallow my words. If I have something to say.*

after_kakao_end.name: Me
after_kakao_end.text: *I take out my phone again and leave the group chat. Done. — I belong to this school now.*

after_miss_dain_1.name: Me
after_miss_dain_1.text: *Walking down the hallway when I hear heavy footsteps behind me.*

after_miss_dain_3.name: Me
after_miss_dain_3.text: *I dodge to the side reflexively. 다인(Dain) zooms past me. Running, then a sudden stop.*

after_miss_dain_5.name: Me
after_miss_dain_5.text: Why are you sprinting in the hallway?

after_miss_dain_6.name: 다인(Dain)
after_miss_dain_6.text: I'm late! Gotta get to the gym! — Oh, see you tomorrow! Transfer kid!

after_miss_dain_7.name: Me
after_miss_dain_7.text: *She waves and runs off. Like a storm. We haven't even properly introduced ourselves and she's already this casual.*

after_miss_yuna_1.name: Me
after_miss_yuna_1.text: *Passing by the library when I notice a girl with drowsy eyes walking while reading a book.*

after_miss_yuna_4.name: Me
after_miss_yuna_4.text: *And she walks on. That's it. But — something about her stays in my mind.*

after_miss_seoyeon_1.name: Me
after_miss_seoyeon_1.text: *On my way out, I run into 서연(Seoyeon) in the hallway.*

after_miss_seoyeon_4.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
after_miss_seoyeon_4.text: Lunch. I left the rooftop open. Making me wait — bold move for a transfer student.

after_miss_seoyeon_6.name: 서연(Seoyeon)
after_miss_seoyeon_6.text: ...I went up for some air and the door happened to be open.

after_miss_seoyeon_7.name: Me
after_miss_seoyeon_7.text: *She definitely waited. — I feel a little sorry, and oddly, a little amused.*
